subject: Supplier Enrollment: Sprint Kickoff & Purchase Order Readiness
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Hayes <j.hayes@bluecrest.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier Enrollment: Sprint Kickoff & PO readiness

Jordan —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. To get Bluecrest live on Dedicated capacity and ensure the first invoice flows cleanly, can we schedule a short kickoff to align on the enrollment checklist and PO handoff? Proposed objectives:

- Confirm owners for procurement tasks (PO submit, billing contact, legal redlines)
- Agree on timeline for onboarding forms, SOC2 evidence intake, and test traffic window
- Review PO template and any special billing requirements from Bluecrest
- Identify success criteria for the launch sprint (throughput targets, data boundaries, go/no-go)

I attached our vendor onboarding form and a PO template for your team to review. Can you share availability for a 30–45 min call this week? If it helps, we suggest: Tue 10/20 10:00–10:45 PT or Wed 10/21 14:00–14:45 PT.

If Bluecrest prefers to fill the onboarding PDF before the call, that would speed things up; otherwise we can walk through the fields and capture responses live.

Thanks — look forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: RI-vendor-onboarding-form_v2.pdf (form), PO-template_Bluecrest.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Jordan Hayes <j.hayes@bluecrest.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@bluecrest.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Supplier Enrollment: Sprint Kickoff & PO readiness

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the clear note. We can do Tue 10/20 at 10:00 PT. I invited our procurement lead (ProcureOps) to the thread — they'll own the PO execution. A few quick questions in advance so we can come prepared:

1) Does Redwood accept our standard PO terms or do you require your PO template to be used?
2) Are there minimum billing fields we must include to avoid delays? (billing contact, legal entity name, tax ID)
3) Will the onboarding form require security attachments (SOC2, penetration test report) to be uploaded before the first test?

I attached our internal briefing doc (I can forward the full legal team redline if needed after the kickoff).

See you Tuesday.

—Jordan Hayes
Director of Partnerships
Bluecrest Analytics
j.hayes@bluecrest.com | +1 (212) 555-2104

On Mon, Oct 19, 2026 at 8:02 AM Jordan Hayes <j.hayes@bluecrest.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the clear note. We can do Tue 10/20 at 10:00 PT...

Jordan / Naomi —

Quick context from the infra side so the kickoff can be focused:
- Primary technical stakeholder: Marcus Lin (I'll coordinate model variants and test window).
- Secondary: Priyom Das (security intake & data handling).

For PO fields: including legal entity name, billing address, PO number, and invoice email is usually sufficient. If Bluecrest has standard contract terms (GTC), send them ahead of the call; we typically use our SLA addendum for Dedicated capacity.

On security artifacts: SOC2 report and a brief architecture diagram showing where data is stored are helpful. If you cannot share SOC2 before the call we can still proceed but will flag any policy dependencies (e.g., data residency).

I've added a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) outline to the Drive link Naomi shared — it includes the timeline we normally run for a 2-week onboarding sprint and owners for each task. Happy to surface a condensed checklist during the call.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Inference Runtime
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachment referenced: Data-flow-questions.docx (simple checklist for architecture diagram)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Hayes <j.hayes@bluecrest.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, ProcureOps <procureops@bluecrest.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Supplier Enrollment: Sprint Kickoff & PO readiness

Great — thanks all, call confirmed Tue 10/20 10:00–10:30 PT (calendar invite sent). Final agenda below (30 mins):

1) Introductions & roles (3 min) — Naomi / Jordan / Marcus / Priyom / Bluecrest proc ops
2) Procurement items (PO template vs Bluecrest PO) (8 min) — confirm required fields and signer
3) Onboarding form walkthrough (7 min) — key fields, attachments, and expected timelines
4) Security & evidence intake (SOC2, architecture diagram) (6 min) — Priyom to advise on must-have vs optional
5) Sprint timeline & success criteria (6 min) — agree on go/no-go and test traffic window

Pre-work request: please upload any legal redlines and SOC2/arch diagram to the Drive link ahead of the call if possible. If not, bring the point person for procurement on the call and we'll capture next steps.

Post-call deliverables (we'll drive these items):
- Finalized mutual action plan in Drive (owner & due dates)
- Completed onboarding form or captured answers in meeting notes
- PO issuance or pointer to Bluecrest PO + required fields for invoice

If anyone needs a longer slot, we can extend to 45 min, but the goal is to keep the kickoff tight.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
